in_sanskrit.name: युगान्त
in_sanskrit.meaning: End of an age or cycle
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The end of one cosmic cycle (Mahapralaya) and the beginning of another. Also used to refer to the end of one yuga (age) and the beginning of another.

in_marathi.name: Yugant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Age, Cycle, Time
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yugant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yugant refers to the end of one cycle or age and the beginning of another. It signifies the continuous cycle of time and the idea of progress and change.

in_bengali.name: Yugant
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Age, Cycle, Time
in_bengali.long_meaning: Yugant একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Yugant refers to the end of one cycle or age and the beginning of another. It signifies the continuous cycle of time and the idea of progress and change.
